evidence: Lessons: (1) adding outputSchema exposed a real data gap (Gate-command findings have no id) — the SDK turns a schema mismatch into a tool error, so schemas must be validated against real fixtures; (2) the read-only invariant of the spec-drift server was documented in three places and the plan nearly broke it — decisions stay at the CLI, views show the command; (3) server-side aggregation (audit_query) gives most of code mode's benefit on every host; (4) harness: committing a file deletion inside a directory scope changes evidence_hash (DRIFT-02 noise) — follow-up; (5) mcp.e2e analyze_spec_drift sets env after import — follow-up.
